scope: Live campaign PVE finish → MatchEnd → battle_to_home → availableStages

evidencePolicy.bytecode: GameControllerBattle.sendBattleResult → rpc_s_complete_pve_battle(getBattleResultDict); ClientPlayer.rpc_c_battle_result → MatchEnd; MatchEnd.BackHome → rpc_s_battle_to_home; rpc_c_battle_to_home(level)
evidencePolicy.inferred: Loot scale by destruction%; next-stage unlock from data.pve_stage.pve_next_stage

localAdapter.rpc_s_battle_to_home / leave_battle: route: raid session → enemy-attack finish; else PVE → handlePveBattleToHome
localAdapter.availableStages: [goldLeft,woodLeft,maxStars,passTime]; stock QuestManager.get_mt_stage requires entry[3]>0; local wins set missing marker to 1, preserving existing positive values; unlock pve_next_stage when starNum>=1
localAdapter.legacyMigration: ensureAvailableStages repairs entry[3] to 1 only when stored stars>0 and marker is not positive; exact historical count/time is unknown; no reward replay or quest claim
localAdapter.wallet: Persist loot in home units[].sto with gold/wood capacity limits; battle self keeps own wallet
localAdapter.rewards: applyPveBattleItemRewards follows input_event_client.putin_event_item/putin_event_next, using referenced item_input ids rather than event-id collisions. Fixed first-win prefix items are retained until the shared repeat chain. Shared repeat loot rolls once using the sweep policy: independent knowledge book 33%, unchanged skill odds and rare 8%. Only victories grant these items. Unambiguous hero rewards -> saved roster; sweep_hero_exp -> saved XP + exp_add
localAdapter.receipts: localPveFirstRewards per stage; repeated completion for one session rejected
